notes.name: Wikipedia · Richard Hamilton (artist)
notes.q: His 1955 exhibition Man, Machine and Motion (Hatton Gallery, Newcastle upon Tyne) and his 1956 collage Just what is it that makes today's homes so different, so appealing?, produced for the This Is Tomorrow exhibition of the Independent Group in London, are considered by critics and historians to be among the earliest works of pop art.

notes.name: Wikipedia · Richard Hamilton (artist)
notes.q: In 1951, Hamilton staged an exhibition called Growth and Form at the Institute of Contemporary Arts in London.

notes.name: Wikipedia · Richard Hamilton (artist)
notes.q: Hamilton's 1955 exhibition of paintings at the Hanover Gallery were all in some form a homage to Duchamp.

notes.name: Wikipedia · Richard Hamilton (artist)
notes.q: In 2011 Dublin City Gallery The Hugh Lane showed a joint retrospective exhibition of both Hamilton's and Rita Donagh's work called "Civil Rights etc."
